newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-ERIKSSON CONFIRMS HE IS DESTINED FOR ENGLAND.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ERIKSSON CONFIRMS HE IS DESTINED FOR ENGLAND.

text.p: Sampdoria's Swedish coach Sven-Goran Eriksson confirmed on Sunday that he would be managing English premier league club Blackburn next season.
"The decision's final, I will be going to England," Eriksson said after watching his young Samp side defeat Milan 3-2 at the San Siro with 10 men.
Earlier in the week, Italian newspapers had carried reports that Eriksson was set to join Rome club Lazio after asking Blackburn to release him from a preliminary agreement.
The reports were strenously denied by Blackburn president Roberto Coar.
"The decision was made a month-and-a-half ago, nothing has changed," added Eriksson, who this season has coached a rebuilt Sampdoria side to second place in serie A.
